android.desc:
It must go down as the most top-notch and delicate wallpaper app so far, download it to make your smartphone unique and super-gorgeous. - Editor's Pick from AppEggs.com

... Now you can have the newest and coolest live wallpaper available...

MadMarbles LITE live wallpaper renders REAL marbles in your device home screen.



MadMarbles LITE features interactive realtime marbles moving, colliding and affecting the wallpaper image like real marbles would!


Users can slide individual marbles with their finger and control all marbles according to the device orientation or let them move automatically.
Adjust size and color intensity as you want.



Double tapping creates a new set of marbles.

MadMarbles LITE features a  battery save mode.



Features of the LITE version:
 
- accurate physics

- move individual marbles

- adjust marble color intensity

- move marbles by moving your device

- choose between 3 default background images

- change marbles size

- change the number of marbles displayed

- control marbles with device orientation or let them move automatically

- control the simulation speed

- control the simulation gravity



Additional features of the FULL version:

- no advertisement

- select your own background image or photo

- select marbles color in single color mode

- multicolor mode with 10 color schemes and adjustable intensity

- add a nice halo effect to your marbles

- an extra background image



HOW TO INSTALL/CONFIGURE:
Home screen->Long tap->Wallpapers->Live Wallpapers->MadMarbles LITE
